strings.name: Guo Guangchang
strings.role: Fosun co-founder and Chairman of Fosun International
strings.summary: Guo Guangchang is a Fosun co-founder, Chairman of Fosun International and a Fudan University graduate. He started a business with classmates in 1992 and subsequently engaged in insurance, pharmaceuticals, consumer businesses and tourism through operations and international investment. Fosun International listed in Hong Kong in 2007.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Only the birth year 1967, supported by a regulatory disclosure, is used. Assistance with an investigation, public appearances, company results and investment plans are distinguished.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded Fosun, connecting insurance, pharmaceuticals, consumer businesses and tourism through international investment.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Earned a bachelor’s degree in philosophy from Fudan University in 1989 and an MBA there in 1999.
strings.facts.f2.label: Current role
strings.facts.f2.value: Serves as Executive Director and Chairman of Fosun International; the chairmanship is distinct from the group’s Co-CEO roles.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Insurance and industrial investment
strings.highlights.h1.text: Fosun expanded internationally through transactions including Portuguese insurance acquisitions; corporate purchases and expected synergies are not personal wealth or realized returns.
strings.highlights.h2.title: 2015 investigation disclosure
strings.highlights.h2.text: On December 11, the company said he was assisting mainland judicial authorities with investigations. His public appearance at a company meeting on the 14th establishes neither closure nor conviction.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Attended Guangzhou investment conference
strings.timeline.t1.text: Discussed healthcare and tourism plans as Chairman of Fosun International; the future projects described remained plans.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Attended interim results conference
strings.timeline.t2.text: The previous evening, the company announced half-year revenue of RMB86.96 billion and profit attributable to owners of the parent of RMB1.72 billion; the conference date differs from the results announcement.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Reappeared publicly at a company meeting
strings.timeline.t3.text: Attended the company’s Shanghai annual meeting after disclosure of his assistance with investigations; public appearance does not establish the final legal outcome.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Completed Portuguese insurance acquisition
strings.timeline.t4.text: Fosun completed its purchase of 80% of the equity and voting rights in each of Fidelidade, Multicare and Cares.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Fosun International listed in Hong Kong
strings.timeline.t5.text: The company joined the Hong Kong Stock Exchange’s Main Board under stock code 00656.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Earned an MBA
strings.timeline.t6.text: Obtained an MBA at Fudan University, distinct from his earlier philosophy bachelor’s degree.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Started a business with classmates
strings.timeline.t7.text: Co-founded Shanghai Guangxin Technology Development Company with Fudan classmates, working in market research at the start of Fosun’s entrepreneurial history.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completed undergraduate philosophy studies
strings.timeline.t8.text: Graduated from Fudan University with a bachelor’s degree in philosophy.
